verdict.rationale: The only security-relevant documentation is thin. The Agent Skills spec defines an experimental `allowed-tools` field for pre-approved tools a skill may use, and notes that skills can bundle scripts, which touches on 'what skills can execute.' The CLI also offers a `--list` path to review a skill before installing it. No trust model for third-party skills is documented. Data collection is also undocumented: community users note the leaderboard is ranked by install counts gathered through `npx skills`, and that this was not explained on the site. missing for 10: a documented trust/verification model for third-party skills, a telemetry/data-collection disclosure, a non-experimental execution-permission model, and a consolidated security posture doc.
